prospective_change.unchanged: Original scene salt and three candidate places.
prospective_change.new_seq1_selection: 16 uniform chronological member ranks; round-half-up(k*(N-1)/15), k=0..15.
prospective_change.rationale: Prospective connected multiview coverage before any image, K, pose or estimator outcome.

selection.role_rule: 1-based odd selected positions B; even selected positions C.
selection.reference_rule: A->each C; each B->3 C nearest by absolute actual frame-number difference.
selection.distance_ties: Lower actual C frame number, then filename.
selection.query_rule: A->each B; query edges are excluded from the reference edge set.

future_evaluation_only.prerequisite: All scientific predictions sealed before any pose download or read.

interpretation: Unadopted development proposal only. Graph adjacency does not establish image overlap, parallax, motion diversity or method efficacy. If adopted, the three places become development forever; other 62 cached scene IDs remain unallocated.
